2. Plaint case in short is that the suit property measuring an area of 6.30 acres of land belonged to Asutosh Sarker, Jagodish Sarker, Hrishikesh Sarker, Debendra Nath Sarkar and Gaugamoyee Sarker. The plaintiffs predecessor took settlement of the said lands from the said landlords by several amalnamas and they were recognized as Korfa tenants under khatian Nos. 22-31 of the landlords khatian no. 21. The lands were accordingly recorded in the C. S. khatian in the names of the plaintiffs-predecessors and they exercised their title and possession over statutory period. Of the said tenants, Adam Pramanik died leaving the plaintiff no. 1 as daughter and brother the plaintiff no. 2 who died leaving behind two sons namely Afer Pramanik and Wafor Pramanik, who also died leaving 3 sons the plaintiffs no. 3-5. Afer Pramanik died leaving 4, sons the plaintiffs no. 6-9. Rabi Pramanik died leaving one daughter the plaintiff no. 10. Gazi Pramanik died leaving sons namely Biru Pramanik and Miruddin Pramanik. Biru Pramanik died leaving two sons the plain-tiffs no. 11 and 12. Arajdi Pramanik died leaving son the plaintiff no. 13 and other plaintiffs have also inherited the suit lands from their predecessors. The plaintiff no.1 also sold some lands to plaintiffs no. 21-32 on 9th April, 1979. The defendants no. 3-9 gifted .33 acres of land in favour of plaintiff no. 47. The plaintiff nos. 23-29 sold 30 acres of land to plaintiffs Monjur Rahman, Abdul Kader and Mohsin Reza. Some other plaintiffs also sold some lands to other plaintiffs and in this way they have been in possession by way of inheritance and purchase. The defendants have no right title and interest in the suit lands. During the last settlement operation the record was initially prepared in the names of their predecessors but subsequently it was detected that the S.A. khatians were prepared in the name of Jagodish Sarker which was incorrect. During the war of liberation the plaintiffs documents were destroyed and taking advantage of the situation, the defendant no. 1 created some ante dated papers and instituted a suit in the Court of Munsif, Sirajgonj and obtained a fraudulent decree by practicing fraud upon the Court. The plaintiffs are not bound by the said decree. During the R.S. operation the plaintiffs went to record their names, when the defendant no. 1 protested by producing the said fraudulent decree. Accordingly, the plaintiffs title was clouded. 

 3. The defendant nos. 2, 5 and 6 filed two separate written statements but the defendant no.2 did not contest the suit. The case of the defendant nos. 5 and 6 who are respondent nos. 1 and 2 is that they purchased the suit lands measuring 6.30 acres appertaining to C.S. khatian nos. 22-31 by two registered deeds dated 30th December, 1976. Their further case is that the suit lands belonged to Jagodish Sarker, Asutosh Sarker, Hrishikesh Sarker, Debendra Nath Sarker, sons of Taroni Chandra Sarker and Gongamoyee Sarker, wife of late Taroni Sarker While aforesaid owners were enjoying the said lands by an amicable partition, Jagodish Chandra Sarker got the suit lands while other co-sharers, the defendants no. 2 and 3 got 100 bighas of land under mouja Porjona. Jagodish Chandra Sarker settled the said lands to the predecessor of the defendants namely Hossain Ali on 11th Kartick, 1352 B.S. During the S. A. operation Jagodish Chandra's name was wrongly recorded. Accordingly Hossain Ali instituted Title Suit No. 140 of 1975 in the Court of Subordinate Judge, Pabna for declaration of title against Jagodish Chandra Sarker and the suit was decreed exparte on 29th January, 1974. In pursuance of the decree Hossain Ali's name was recorded in the S. A. khatian. Subsequently Hossain Ali instituted Other Class Suit No. 282 of 1976 against Assistant Custodian for permanent injunction. During the R. S. operation Jagodish Chandra Sarker's name was recorded but on appeal, the defendants name was corrected. The defendant no. 6 thereupon transferred some lands to Hossain Ali Sarker, Sufia Khatun, Sakera Khatun and 3 others. The plaintiffs have no right, title and interest in the suit land.
